searchText: Hi <@301186049323958275>! I couldn't find any analysis on the splitting zero attack (https://eprint.iacr.org/2021/323.pdf) against aggregate bls signatures. Is there any writeup on that? I know nothing about BLS, so am not the right person to ask. 😬 Thanks <@301186049323958275>! Is there anyone we can discuss? I mean i saw that the earlier version of this attack was solved by adding a nonzero secret key check during the registration. But I couldn't see any action for the newer version which is basically against aggregation. BTW i hope this is the right place to ask thi question 🙂
